newsitem.title: GAMBIA: Army leader takes comfortable lead in Gambia poll.
newsitem.headline: Army leader takes comfortable lead in Gambia poll.

text.p: Gambia's military leader Colonel Yahya Jammeh took a comfortable lead over his closest civilian rival with more than half the results of presidential elections declared officially on Friday, the electoral commission said.
Returns from 28 of 45 constituencies in the West African country put Jammeh ahead with 76,790 votes and his strongest challenger, lawyer Ousainou Darboe, with 58,356.
Two marginal civilian candidates polled 9,905 and 3,125 votes. Full results were expected later on Friday.
